|rulings=* The revealed cards may be deployed in any order.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Panic Scomp: Panic]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Does not circumvent any deployment rules such as requiring presence or Force icons, [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] rules, etc.
* All cards revealed but not deployed are lost.
* If the player somehow shuffles the Reserve Deck, any remaining revealed cards are un-revealed and shuffled in, ending the action.
* If the player somehow activates or loses Force from Reserve Deck while the top card is revealed, it is un-revealed and then activated/lost normally.
